description.en: Creates a low-detail (non-talking) cutscene character model from raw face/body model numbers, and — unless suppressed — also creates its matching bustup portrait via CreateBustup.
Name to assign the created model.
Body model ID (also used as the shoes ID, and the glove ID when _keeper is true).
Optional; whether to use the home uniform variant (defaults to true).
Optional; whether the character is a goalkeeper (defaults to false).
Optional event-specific flag passed through to CMND_CREATE_CHARA (defaults to false).
Optional memory pool to allocate the model from (defaults to DEV_MEM_NAME_EVENT).
Optional; when true, skips creating the matching bustup portrait (defaults to false).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a low-detail cutscene character model with its bustup portrait
local hShinsukeL = CreateEvLowMdlForNumber("shinsukeL", 5, 902);
